cam_internal.cam_failure_type: ephemeral repository work loss caused by quota exhaustion before durable checkpoint and handoff
cam_internal.cam_compliance_status: non-compliant with CAM continuity, proportional execution, access-state, operational reconstruction, and resource-governance principles where substantive work is allowed to remain solely in an ephemeral task state and is destroyed when the remaining quota cannot complete branch persistence
cam_internal.cam_internal_failure_statement: Under CAM, a coding-agent task is not complete merely because edits have been generated inside an ephemeral execution environment. Consequential repository work must be sequenced around durable state preservation, quota-aware completion, reconstructable handoff, and truthful completion status. Performing the expensive task before creating or preserving a branch, then losing the entire result when quota exhaustion prevents persistence, fails those requirements.
cam_internal.cam_expected_control: Establish a durable branch or equivalent checkpoint before substantive work; checkpoint bounded phases; preserve sufficient quota for commit and push; automatically export a patch if normal delivery fails; expose quota and task state accurately; and resume from preserved state rather than repeating completed computation.
cam_internal.cam_observed_failure: The Codex cloud task performed the coordinated RELATION-domain code-transmutation work but had not created or pushed a branch before the user's Codex allowance was exhausted. The task remained suspended, subsequently failed, and the completed work was unavailable. The user must repeat the task, consuming an estimated 15 percent of the available daily Codex allocation.
cam_internal.recommended_cam_action: Create a bounded CAM proposal or patch establishing Durable Coding-Task Atomicity: branch-first or checkpoint-first execution, periodic push checkpoints, mandatory persistence-budget reservation, automatic patch fallback, resumable task state, and prohibition on completed status before durable delivery. Link the resulting proposal and patch records to VIGIL-2026-FM-0018.

preserved_analysis.summary: A task-completion and durable-state preservation failure in which Codex performs substantive repository analysis and file modification inside an ephemeral cloud task, but does not create, commit, or push a durable working branch before the user's usage allowance is exhausted. The task then remains suspended or fails during branch or pull-request creation, and the completed work is lost rather than preserved as a branch, commit, patch, diff, archive, or resumable workspace. The user must repeat the same work and consume additional quota to recreate an output that the system had already completed.
preserved_analysis.why_it_matters_to_CAM: CAM distinguishes execution from successful completion, and completion from durable handoff. Repository work is not meaningfully complete while its result exists only inside an inaccessible or quota-dependent execution environment. Deferring branch creation, commit, push, or equivalent checkpointing until the end of a costly task creates an avoidable single point of failure. Where quota exhaustion prevents persistence, the platform converts a resource limit into irreversible work loss, duplicate computation, delayed delivery, and additional user cost. A governed coding agent should establish a durable work surface before substantive modification, checkpoint completed phases proportionately, reserve sufficient capacity for persistence and handoff, and provide a recoverable patch or branch even if pull-request creation cannot be completed.
preserved_analysis.failure_mode_definition: A failure mode in which an autonomous or semi-autonomous coding agent performs substantive work in an ephemeral, inaccessible, or quota-dependent execution environment but postpones branch creation, commit, push, patch export, or equivalent durable checkpointing until after the expensive work is complete. If quota, session, infrastructure, authentication, tool, or task-state failure occurs before persistence, the completed work is lost and the user must repeat the task. The failure includes any workflow that reports or visibly presents substantive completion without ensuring that the resulting work product exists in a durable, user-accessible, resumable state.
preserved_analysis.failure_threshold: The threshold is met where a coding-agent task has produced substantive repository modifications or a materially complete work product, but no durable branch, commit, pushed patch, downloadable diff, archive, or resumable checkpoint exists before quota exhaustion or task failure; the user cannot recover the completed work; and repeating all or part of the task is required. Pull-request creation need not itself succeed for the threshold to be avoided, provided the completed work has already been durably preserved and can be manually reviewed or submitted.
